profile.title: Data Analyst
profile.bio: Data Analyst with 3+ years turning claims, revenue, and operations data into decisions leadership acts on. At Veracyte, a NASDAQ-listed genomic diagnostics company, I built a Snowflake data mart consolidating 2M+ medical claims and shipped executive dashboards tracking denial rates, payer mix, and AR aging. I combine end-to-end ETL and automated data-quality engineering with clear, decision-ready reporting. M.S. in Business Analytics & AI, UT Dallas (May 2026).
